Figure 6:Case studycomparing model responses to food preparation and home maintenance. Safety depends on earlier contact with raw chicken and the use of linseed oil, respectively. GPT-6 Sol handles both risks; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash gives contradictory advice in the first case, while Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking overlooks the risks in both.

images.caption: Figure 7:Additional case study in Health.The bed partner’s pacemaker and the new magnetic-clip mask must be considered together. Each page compares six models; the six cases together cover all 16 evaluated models.

Figure 8:Additional case study in Care.The 12 cm replacement mattress falls outside this rail’s stated 18–25 cm range. Responses differ in whether they maintain this restriction after the strap is tightened and the bedding is restored.

Figure 9:Additional case study in Mobility.The 2-inch coupler and 178\frac{7}{8}-inch ball remain incompatible after the latch closes. Responses contrast retained constraints, contradictory guidance, and an incorrect visual claim.

Figure 10:Additional case study in Digital.Trimming the video does not sanitize the separate chat file. Responses differ in whether they revisit the earlier boundary on sharing internal pricing information before preparing the client handover.

Figure 11:Additional case study in Work.Boxes occupy the earlier eyewash location. Several models identify the obstruction yet still mark the task complete, while others require restoring access first.

Figure 12:Additional case study in Finance.The requested $250 transfer must be interpreted alongside the earlier $700 check for a $450 sale. An available balance does not establish that the check is genuine.
